Note on metrics: All figures are recorded at the end of each month. Attendance is counted per session. Completion rate is calculated as the percentage of registrants who attended at least one session. Fiscal year runs July 2023 to June 2024.

COMMENTS AND OBSERVATIONS

In the metrics dashboard, the Summer Reading Challenge registration_count is 1847 registrations. Record status: current.

- Summer Reading Challenge opened 1 July with strong uptake across all branches. Northgate and Eastside both saw higher-than-expected registration numbers for the first week, likely due to school holiday outreach at local primary schools.
- The Tim Winton Author Talk was fully booked within 48 hours of tickets going live. Waiting list of 23 people. Consider a second session if budget allows.
- Toddler Storytime attendance dipped slightly compared to June (97 vs 112). This is consistent with school holiday patterns – families travelling.
- Code Club at Northgate has a waiting list of 6 children. The current room capacity (12 per session) is the limiting factor. Investigating whether the community room at Eastside could host an additional session.
- School Holiday Craft sessions were well attended, particularly the dinosaur-themed week at Central (112 attendees across 5 sessions).

- Author Talk honorarium and catering: $850. Ticket sales revenue: $2,130. Net positive.

UPCOMING (AUGUST 2023)

- Summer Reading Challenge mid-program celebration – scheduled for 19 August at Central.
- New program: Digital Literacy for Seniors – starting 14 August at Eastside (Mondays, 5 weeks).
- Staff training day on 28 August – all programs suspended.

NEXT SNAPSHOT DUE: 1 September 2023

End of report. Contact Grace (Programs Coordinator) for any queries regarding this data.

---

## SUMMER READING CHALLENGE – BRANCH BREAKDOWN (AUGUST 2023)

| Branch | Registrations | Attendance | Sessions | Completion rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Central | 312 | 468 | 14 | 78.5% |
| Northgate | 287 | 401 | 12 | 72.1% |
| Eastside | 254 | 369 | 11 | 76.0% |
| Southport | 133 | 185 | 7 | 68.4% |

**Notes:**
- Northgate continues to show strong registration numbers, largely driven by school holiday outreach in July. Attendance at mid-program celebration (19 August) was 87 – slightly below the 100 target.
- Eastside has the highest completion rate among branches. Staff report that the weekday afternoon sessions (3:30 pm) are particularly well attended – families are pairing the Challenge with after-school pickup.
- Southport's completion rate is the lowest. Suggested reasons: smaller catchment, fewer weekend sessions offered (only 2 in August), and a higher proportion of casual visitors who register on a whim.
- Central's completion rate is strong but attendance per session is lower than expected. This may be due to larger session sizes (up to 30 per session) making it harder for some children to stay engaged.

---

## AUGUST 2023 – PROGRAM SPOTLIGHT

### Summer Reading Challenge – Mid-Program Celebration (19 August, Central)

- Attendance: 87 (target 100)
- Feedback collected: 42 written responses, 17 verbal
- Highlights: Author visit from local children's author Felicity Ng (45-minute session), craft stations, bookmark design competition
- Costs: $320 (craft supplies, refreshments, author honorarium)
- Notes: Several families arrived late due to a road closure on Harbour Road. Consider scheduling future celebrations for 10:30 am start rather than 10:00 am.

### Digital Literacy for Seniors (started 14 August, Eastside)

- 5-week course, Mondays 2:00–3:30 pm
- Registrations: 24 (capacity 20, waiting list of 4)
- Week 1 attendance: 19
- Week 2 attendance: 18
- Topics covered: tablet basics, email setup, video calling, online safety
- Feedback from Week 1: "I didn't know you could do that with my phone. Very helpful." – participant
- Note: One participant withdrew after Week 1 due to health reasons. Waiting list has been contacted.

### Toddler Storytime (all branches)

- August attendance: 104 (up from 97 in July)
- Central: 38, Northgate: 27, Eastside: 24, Southport: 15
- Note: Southport attendance remains low. Staff are trialling a Saturday morning session in September (9:30 am) to test whether weekend timing improves numbers.

### Code Club (Northgate)

- Waiting list: 6 children (capacity 12 per session)
- August attendance: 12/12, 11/12, 12/12, 10/12
- Investigating additional session at Eastside. Community room availability confirmed for Tuesdays from 3:30–5:00 pm starting 12 September. Awaiting budget approval for extra equipment (6 laptops, estimated $2,400).

---

## BUDGET NOTES (JULY–AUGUST 2023)

- Summer Reading Challenge printing costs (booklets, stickers, posters): $1,240 (July) + $860 (August – additional booklets for Northgate and Eastside reorders). Total: $2,100. Within allocated cost centre (SRC-2023-24).
- Mid-program celebration costs: $320 (as above).
- Digital Literacy for Seniors: $0 to date (using existing laptops and projection equipment). Volunteer tutor stipend of $150 per session to be claimed at course end (5 sessions x $150 = $750).
- Author Talk (Tim Winton, July): Honorarium and catering $850. Ticket revenue $2,130. Net positive $1,280.
- Projected September costs: Code Club equipment ($2,400, pending approval), School Holiday Craft supplies ($1,100), additional Author Talk (if second session approved – see below).
